`resetall
`timescale 1ns / 1ps
`default_nettype none

module priority_encoder #(
    parameter WIDTH = 4,
    parameter LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY = 0
)(
    input  wire [WIDTH-1:0] input_unencoded,
    output wire output_valid,
    output wire [$clog2(WIDTH)-1:0] output_encoded,
    output wire [WIDTH-1:0] output_unencoded
);

parameter LEVELS = WIDTH > 2 ? $clog2(WIDTH) : 1;
parameter W = 2**LEVELS;

generate
if (WIDTH == 256 && LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY == 0 && LEVELS == 8 && W == 256) begin : fast_256
    wire [15:0] group_valid;
    wire [15:0] group_select;
    wire [15:0] local_select [0:15];
    wire [3:0] local_code [0:15];
    wire [15:0] code_terms [0:3];

    genvar g, b, k;
    for (g = 0; g < 16; g = g + 1) begin : groups
        wire [15:0] bits_in;
        assign bits_in = input_unencoded[g*16 +: 16];
        assign group_valid[g] = |bits_in;

        if (g == 15) begin : highest_group
            assign group_select[g] = group_valid[g];
        end else begin : other_group
            assign group_select[g] = group_valid[g] & ~(|group_valid[15:g+1]);
        end

        for (b = 0; b < 16; b = b + 1) begin : bits
            if (b == 15) begin : highest_bit
                assign local_select[g][b] = bits_in[b];
            end else begin : other_bit
                assign local_select[g][b] = bits_in[b] & ~(|bits_in[15:b+1]);
            end

            if (g == 0 && b == 0) begin : invalid_default
                assign output_unencoded[g*16+b] =
                    (group_select[g] & local_select[g][b]) | ~output_valid;
            end else begin : ordinary_output
                assign output_unencoded[g*16+b] =
                    group_select[g] & local_select[g][b];
            end
        end

        assign local_code[g][0] = |(local_select[g] & 16'haaaa);
        assign local_code[g][1] = |(local_select[g] & 16'hcccc);
        assign local_code[g][2] = |(local_select[g] & 16'hf0f0);
        assign local_code[g][3] = |(local_select[g] & 16'hff00);

        for (k = 0; k < 4; k = k + 1) begin : encode_terms
            assign code_terms[k][g] = group_select[g] & local_code[g][k];
        end
    end

    assign output_valid = |group_valid;
    assign output_encoded[7:4] = {
        |(group_select & 16'hff00),
        |(group_select & 16'hf0f0),
        |(group_select & 16'hcccc),
        |(group_select & 16'haaaa)
    };
    for (k = 0; k < 4; k = k + 1) begin : low_code
        assign output_encoded[k] = |code_terms[k];
    end
end else begin : original_parameters
    wire [W-1:0] input_padded = {{W-WIDTH{1'b0}}, input_unencoded};
    wire [W/2-1:0] stage_valid [LEVELS-1:0];
    wire [W/2-1:0] stage_enc [LEVELS-1:0];
    genvar l, n;

    for (n = 0; n < W/2; n = n + 1) begin : loop_in
        assign stage_valid[0][n] = |input_padded[n*2+1:n*2];
        if (LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY) begin : lsb
            assign stage_enc[0][n] = !input_padded[n*2];
        end else begin : msb
            assign stage_enc[0][n] = input_padded[n*2+1];
        end
    end

    for (l = 1; l < LEVELS; l = l + 1) begin : loop_levels
        for (n = 0; n < W/(2*2**l); n = n + 1) begin : loop_compress
            assign stage_valid[l][n] = |stage_valid[l-1][n*2+1:n*2];
            if (LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY) begin : lsb
                assign stage_enc[l][(n+1)*(l+1)-1:n*(l+1)] =
                    stage_valid[l-1][n*2] ?
                    {1'b0, stage_enc[l-1][(n*2+1)*l-1:(n*2)*l]} :
                    {1'b1, stage_enc[l-1][(n*2+2)*l-1:(n*2+1)*l]};
            end else begin : msb
                assign stage_enc[l][(n+1)*(l+1)-1:n*(l+1)] =
                    stage_valid[l-1][n*2+1] ?
                    {1'b1, stage_enc[l-1][(n*2+2)*l-1:(n*2+1)*l]} :
                    {1'b0, stage_enc[l-1][(n*2+1)*l-1:(n*2)*l]};
            end
        end
    end

    assign output_valid = stage_valid[LEVELS-1];
    assign output_encoded = stage_enc[LEVELS-1];
    assign output_unencoded = 1 << output_encoded;
end
endgenerate
endmodule

`resetall

  },
  "rewrite": "Use sixteen parallel 16-input local priority selectors and a 16-input group priority selector. Direct higher-bit reductions determine local and group winners. Form one-hot outputs directly from those winners, independently of output_encoded. Form the high encoded nibble from the selected group and the low nibble by an OR reduction of group-qualified local codes. This exposes parallel reduction and AND/OR logic instead of requiring an encoded result before generating one-hot outputs. Other parameter configurations retain the original implementation.",

  },
  "functional_boundaries": {
    "interface": "Module name, port names, port widths, original parameter names and defaults are preserved. The implementation is entirely combinational.",
    "fixed_instance": "For WIDTH=256 and LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY=0, group_select identifies exactly the highest nonempty group, and local_select identifies exactly its highest set bit. Both encoded nibbles therefore describe the highest set input index.",
    "zero_input": "All local and group selectors and all encoded terms are zero. Consequently output_valid=0, output_encoded=0, and the explicit correction sets only output_unencoded[0], producing output_unencoded=1.",
    "restrictions": "No input restrictions, assumptions, state, don't-cares, or masked invalid outputs are introduced. Formal equivalence must compare every output bit for every binary input, including zero."
  }
